responses.positioning: Simply AI Solutions is the practical guide for small businesses that want AI help without handing their data to a cloud vendor: local-first, honest about limits, hybrid when it pays.
responses.audience_summary: Owners and operations leads of 5-50 person businesses who handle client data and are wary of cloud AI costs and privacy.
key_messages: Your proprietary data can stay on your own machine.
Routine AI work does not need per-token cloud fees.
Use frontier models only where they clearly win.
responses.primary_cta: Book a free 20-minute local-AI readiness call
responses.rationale: LinkedIn reaches decision makers at small businesses; X extends reach for the contrarian cost angle.
